newsitem.title: SPAIN: Antena 3 joins Canalsatellite Digital TV group.
newsitem.headline: Antena 3 joins Canalsatellite Digital TV group.

text.p: The board of Spain's Antena 3 Television S.A. said on Wednesday that it unanimously decided to join Canalsatellite's Digital platform with a 7.5 percent stake.
Its Gestora de Medios Audiovisuales (GMA) group, which holds Antena 3's soccer broadcast rights, will also take a 7.5 percent stake in the group.
The group added that it was calling an extraordinary shareholders meeting for February 18, during which it would explain shareholding changes in the group, as well as its recent key decisions.
Canalsatellite Digital, which is due to launch its project on Thursday, got a big boost last month when Antena 3 decided against a rival project spearheaded by Telefonica de Espana .
